story: Mute Your Microphone While Typing with Hushboard
text: If you have an RTX card, get nVidia Broadcast. If you have a non-RTX card (like a GTX 1070), get RTX voice. Despite the name, it does not require an RTX card. Seriously, nVidia's noise removal is absolute magic, as far as I'm concerned. [VIDEO]

story: Discord has won over gamers. Now it wants everybody else
text: > someone else's background or breathing noise NVIDIA Broadcast (Previously called RTX Voice) is a godsend for those scenarios. If you haven't seen it, it's worth checking out. It is absolutely magical. [VIDEO] Sadly, AFAIK, it does require an NVIDIA GPU, but it doesn't need an RTX card. I used it on my GTX 1070 and it worked wonderfully. What's really amazing about it is that you can use it to filter incoming voice audio, so if you have someone in your channel that has tons of background noise or breathing, you can filter it out on your own side.

story: Show HN: Unclack – a macOS app that mutes your microphone while you type
text: A solution like rtx voice seems a better way to go tbh. For those who don't know, it's an nvidia thing that uses a GPU accelerated (ofc, it's nvidia) neural network to denoise voice calls, from all kinds of noise, not just typing. It's really pretty impressive, here's a demo: [VIDEO] I wish it wasn't proprietary though (and worse, hardware specific). And windows only of course.

story: Enhance Speech from Adobe – Free AI filter for cleaning up spoken audio
text: Nvidia has a similar thing called RTX audio, but its even more impressive and runs live on recording [VIDEO]
